text: my android is attached via adb. I found a tool to try. https://github.com/aabolfazl/adbtop review it. can it help when configuring my phone for better performance

cmd: gh repo view aabolfazl/adbtop 2>&1 | head -80; echo ---; gh api repos/aabolfazl/adbtop/git/trees/HEAD?recursive=1 --jq '.tree[].path' 2>&1 | head -60; echo ---; adb devices 2>&1

cd /tmp 2>/dev/null; gh api 'repos/aabolfazl/adbtop' --jq '{stars:.stargazers_count,created:.created_at,pushed:.pushed_at,license:.license.spdx_id,lang:.language,issues:.open_issues_count}'; gh api 'repos/aabolfazl/adbtop/releases' --jq '.[0:3][]|{tag:.tag_name,date:.published_at}'; gh api 'repos/aabolfazl/adbtop/contents' --jq '.[].name'; echo ---; gh api repos/aabolfazl/adbtop/readme --jq .content | base64 -d | sed -n '80,200p'
adb shell getprop ro.product.model; adb shell getprop ro.build.version.release

cd /tmp; gh api 'repos/aabolfazl/adbtop/contents/Cargo.toml' --jq .content | base64 -d | sed -n '/dependencies/,$p' | head -40; gh api 'repos/aabolfazl/adbtop/contents/src' --jq '.[].name' | tr '\n' ' '

text: yes, install it and run a snapshot

cmd: brew install aabolfazl/tap/adbtop 2>&1 | tail -5; adbtop --help 2>&1 | head -40

cd /private/tmp/claude-504/-Volumes-DAL-Zettelkasten-LLMeon/4f7131d4-fcc7-4bbf-bea5-10e836356bda/scratchpad && adbtop snapshot > snapshot.json 2> snapshot.err; echo exit=$?; wc -c snapshot.json; head -c 600 snapshot.err; jq 'keys' snapshot.json
adb shell dumpsys meminfo 2>&1 | sed -n '1,45p'; echo ...; adb shell dumpsys meminfo 2>&1 | grep -E "Total RAM|Free RAM|Used RAM|Lost RAM|ZRAM|Tuning|cached"
